judge_notes.opus5: Every 2026 print turned on the next quarter's EBIT guide, and the stock rallied ~8% on the audiobook expansion and the Rogan renewal as if they were free while only Jefferies has cut Q4 gross margin; social charges (~EUR 12-13m above the guide assumption) and FX drift add small reported-line negatives.
judge_notes.opus55: Audiobook and Rogan content costs landing on the Q4 margin guide (3), an +8% run into a put-bid skew (6) and MAU risk (2) slightly outweigh the opex-moderation case (4).
judge_notes.sonnet55: Post-guide audiobook and Rogan costs pressure the Q4 gross-margin guide that every 2026 print traded on, after an 8% run, an Inderes downgrade and a downside-paid skew; Q4 opex moderation and ad inflection are the offsets.
judge_notes.fable51: Every 2026 print turned on the next-quarter EBIT guide, and the Q4 guide now has to absorb audiobooks-in-180-markets and the Rogan renewal (item 3) after the stock rallied 8% on that news as if it were free; social-charge drag on reported EBIT (0) and the MAU friction (2) add; opex moderation (4) is the bull case already held.
